caveats: Numbers were reported by the previous team pipeline and are not a new independent replication.
The main and crypto samples differ in events and trading populations; the placebo is not a clean counterfactual for private information.
The small flagged group makes exact comparisons uncertain; grouping related outcomes by event is necessary.
Original trades and a complete position/conversion ledger were not supplied with the uploaded HTML; fees and negative-risk conversions may affect PnL.
Trade timing, sample selection, volume matching, and statistical confidence intervals should be audited using the original archive.
The new probability forecast is an additional research prototype and has not yet been validated on the team's original historical event snapshots.
